description.zh: 通话ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。
description.en: The call ID. Get the CallId from the return parameters of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) interface.

description.zh: 暂停视频播放的手机号码。
description.en: The mobile phone number for which to pause video playback.

descriptions.zh: 目前5G视频通话功能处于邀约制阶段，您需要联系运营经理为您开通此功能。
descriptions.en: The 5G video call feature is available by invitation only. Contact your operations manager to enable it.
